whoIsWisetwin.question: Who is WiseTwin?
whoIsWisetwin.answer: WiseTwin is a consulting and services firm developing digital solutions for industry, founded by three partners with industrial backgrounds. We design tailor-made tools — training, HSE, 3D, data & AI — and publish two products born from recurring client needs: WiseTrainer LMS (training) and WiseAtlas (communication).

whatDoYouDo.question: What do you actually do?
whatDoYouDo.answer: Consulting (transformation diagnosis, industrial performance, operational excellence) and custom development: training digitization, safety inductions, virtual tours, 3D simulators, HSE prevention plans, business applications, production monitoring, artificial intelligence, cloud engineering… If your need is digital and industrial, chances are we can answer it.

productsVsCustom.question: What's the difference between your custom services and your products?
productsVsCustom.answer: Our products (WiseTrainer LMS and WiseAtlas) are recurring needs we standardized: they are immediately available and far cheaper than on-demand development. Custom work covers everything else: we start from your real problem and build the simplest answer. The two often combine — a custom project can build on our products, and vice versa.

whoWorks.question: Who works on my project?
whoWorks.answer: The three partners, directly. Manoel on data, AI and software; Mickaël on 3D, visualization and simulation; Gauthier on consulting and operational excellence. No sales intermediary, no hidden subcontracting: the people you meet are the people who deliver.

clients.question: Who do you work with?
clients.answer: Industrial sites of all sizes — from SMEs to large groups — as well as local authorities and territorial players for WiseAtlas. Our offers are sized to fit a single site's budget, without requiring a central decision.

projectTypes.question: What kinds of projects can we entrust to you?
projectTypes.answer: A few real examples: digitizing a safety induction, creating a virtual risk hunt, simulating a layout or flows before works, producing an HSE prevention plan, developing a business application or a website, setting up production monitoring, explaining a process in 3D or video, building a serious game, or running a digital transformation diagnosis. And anything that looks like these.

smallProjects.question: Do you take on small projects?
smallProjects.answer: Yes — it's actually our philosophy. We prefer to start with a first focused project, on a controlled budget, that delivers a concrete result quickly. Trust builds, then we scale up as we go. Never the other way around.

consultingOnly.question: Can we engage you for consulting only, without development?
consultingOnly.answer: Of course. Digital transformation diagnosis, industrial performance audit, operational excellence roadmap, change management: Gauthier works with industrial leadership teams with or without development behind it. If a tool turns out to be useful, we know how to build it — but it's never a prerequisite.

onsite.question: Do you work on-site?
onsite.answer: Yes, and we recommend it: the best diagnoses happen in the field, alongside your teams. We are based in Dunkerque and travel to your sites across France and Europe. The first discussion can also happen remotely if that's easier for you.

confidentiality.question: How do you guarantee the confidentiality of our industrial data?
confidentiality.answer: We sign a non-disclosure agreement (NDA) from the very first discussion if you wish. Your plans, photos and data are transferred through secure channels — yours if you prefer —, hosted in Europe with restricted access, and we apply ISO 27001 best practices. We work daily with industrial clients subject to strict requirements.

process.question: How does a project unfold?
process.answer: In four steps: 1) a free discussion to understand your need, on-site whenever possible; 2) a proposal with a clear scope, firm price and realistic timeline, within 48h; 3) iterative development with a fast first deliverable and your continuous feedback; 4) deployment, training for your teams and evolutions on demand.

delays.question: What are your timelines?
delays.answer: We work in weeks, not months. A document-based training is digitized in a few days, a photo-realistic safety induction in about a week, a complete 3D simulator in about a month. For custom projects, the timeline is set in the quote — and kept.

assetOwnership.question: Who owns the deliverables?
assetOwnership.answer: You do. The 3D environments, content and custom developments built for your company belong to you 100%. It's your investment, your intellectual property.

interoperability.question: Do your solutions integrate with our existing tools?
interoperability.answer: Yes, it's one of our convictions: no lock-in. SCORM export to your LMS (Moodle, 360Learning, Talentsoft…), SSO with your identity provider, API access, and custom developments that connect to your IT systems rather than replacing them.

aftercare.question: What happens after delivery?
aftercare.answer: We stay available: maintenance, support, and evolutions on demand. Many of our clients grow their tool as they go — one feature at a time, when the need appears. That's exactly how we like to work.

quote.question: How do I get a quote?
quote.answer: Tell us about your project via the contact form — a few lines are enough: context, goal, constraints. We get back to you within 48h with a first assessment and a free quote, with no commitment.

pricingModel.question: How does your pricing work?
pricingModel.answer: Custom services are fixed-price, on quote: clear scope, firm price, no surprises. Our products have public pricing: the WiseTrainer LMS platform starts at €50/month and WiseAtlas at €3,000/year. All quotes are free and without commitment.

wisetrainerPricing.question: How much does the WiseTrainer LMS platform cost?
wisetrainerPricing.answer: The base plan starts at €50/month per site: hosting of your training, WisePaper (document-based training with AI quizzes), Safety Tour (photo-realistic safety induction), completion tracking and unlimited learners. You then add à la carte modules (advanced analytics, training plans, SSO/MFA, SCORM/API…) only when the need appears. Your budget goes into your training content, not the subscription.

simulatorPricing.question: How much does a 3D simulator cost?
simulatorPricing.answer: A WiseTrainer simulator is a custom project billed once, on quote — the price depends on the complexity of your facility and scenarios. The 3D asset is yours, and the platform's base plan is then all you need to deliver it to all your learners, with no per-session cost.

siteBudgets.question: Our budgets are decided at site level, not group level. Is that a problem?
siteBudgets.answer: Quite the opposite — it's our favourite playing field. Our offers are sized for a single site's budget: short projects, controlled prices, a fast concrete return. No need to wait for a group-wide programme to move forward.

security.question: How do you handle data security?
security.answer: Our platforms offer multi-factor authentication (MFA), enterprise SSO (SAML/OAuth), complete audit logs and strict data isolation per organization. We work with demanding industrial clients and apply ISO 27001 best practices.

gdprCompliance.question: How is my learners' data protected?
gdprCompliance.answer: Our solutions are GDPR compliant. All data is hosted on European servers: it never leaves Europe.

noVrHeadset.question: Do I need a VR headset to use your solutions?
noVrHeadset.answer: No. Our solutions are 100% accessible from a standard web browser, on PC, tablet or mobile — €0 hardware investment. VR remains possible when it brings real value: we also build headset experiences when your need justifies it.

installation.question: Do your solutions require installation?
installation.answer: No. Everything is 100% online and accessible from any modern web browser, with no installation. Your teams can train and work from anywhere.

multiSite.question: Do you handle multi-site organizations?
multiSite.answer: Yes. Our platforms support multi-organization management with granular permissions per site, and a sharing module lets you share training between sites or with partners. Each site can also start independently, at its own pace and on its own budget.

technicalRequirements.question: What are the technical requirements?
technicalRequirements.answer: A modern browser (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge) with WebGL support for 3D environments, and a good internet connection to load simulators quickly. That's all.
